report_name: Carterton and the surrounding area Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to identify cycle desire lines and to inform the prioritisation criteria by comparing 2011 census data against the Government Target 2051.
other_tools_developed: Bespoke prioritisation criteria matrix (scoring 0-2 across Effectiveness, Policy, Deliverability, and Cost categories) and Route Selection Tool (RST) for assessing segregated cycle provision.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP identifies 22 prioritised routes for infrastructure improvements, such as segregated cycleways and controlled crossings, which are intended to guide future funding from developer contributions and central government bids to address local safety and connectivity needs.
pct_usage_quote: The development of the cycle network as part of this LCWIP has been an iterative process and has combined the use of Active Travel England’s recommended tools including the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT), as well as local input and knowledge from key stakeholders
